modules.title: 消息队列如何暂存任务并平稳分发
一次报表导出怎样经过消息队列

items.title: 失败前：页面一直等后台做完
items.text: 用户点击导出后，请求同时查询数据、生成文件并上传存储。只要其中一步很慢，页面就会长时间转圈甚至超时，而且用户拿不到一个可以继续查询的任务状态。

items.title: 接入队列，并用任务编号反馈状态
items.text: 接口创建 export_104，把参数和编号写入队列后返回页面；工作进程领取它时更新为处理中，成功则记录文件地址，失败则记录可读原因。页面始终用同一个编号显示排队中、处理中、已完成或失败。入队只表示已受理，不表示文件已经生成。

items.title: 改善证据：四处记录能够对上
items.text: 验收时核对接口响应、队列消息、工作进程日志和页面最终状态都包含 export_104。还要重试一次失败任务，确认不会因重复消费生成两份文件；只有一条“消息已入队”日志不能证明任务完成。

modules.title: 入队成功不等于处理成功
modules.text: 队列的顺序和投递次数取决于具体产品与配置。为了避免消息丢失，常见方案会在未确认时重新投递，因此同一任务可能执行不止一次；Worker 要能识别重复任务，系统也要记录失败、重试和最终状态。这里不展开具体中间件配置。

lessonPractice.title: 用户在商城下单并支付成功后，需要发送确认短信和生成发票。采用消息队列的最主要好处是什么？

options.label: 支付完成后，把短信与开票任务写入队列；接口返回订单结果，后台再分别处理任务
options.feedback: 对。队列让通知与开票不必占用支付请求，但后台仍要处理失败、重试和最终状态。

options.label: 支付接口必须在队列里等待短信和发票全部执行成功，收到全部回执后才能给前端响应
options.feedback: 不对。这依然是同步阻塞，失去了消息队列异步缓冲和解耦的核心价值。

options.label: 任务只要成功进入消息队列，短信就自动送达用户手机，不再需要任何后台消费者处理
options.feedback: 不对。入队成功只是暂存，实际发送由后台消费者执行，入队不代表最终完成。

en.title: After paying for an order, SMS confirmation and invoicing are needed. What is the primary benefit of using a message queue?

options.label: After payment completes, the API enqueues SMS and invoicing tasks, returns the order result, and lets workers process them
options.feedback: Correct. The tasks no longer occupy the payment request, while workers still need failure, retry, and final-state handling.

options.label: The checkout API must block until the queue confirms that both SMS delivery and invoice generation have succeeded
options.feedback: Incorrect. That remains synchronous blocking and defeats the purpose of async queueing.

options.label: Once a task enters the message queue, the SMS is considered delivered without requiring any worker to process it
options.feedback: Incorrect. Enqueueing only stores the job; a background consumer must still execute it.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 这个 Excel 导出会让请求等待很久。请改成异步任务：接口创建任务并写入消息队列，立即返回任务 ID；Worker 用同一个 ID 更新 queued、processing、completed 或 failed，前端据此查询状态。请让重复消费不会生成两份文件，并分别验收正常完成和 Worker 失败后的状态。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: This Excel export blocks the request too long. Make it asynchronous: create and enqueue a job, return its ID immediately, and have the worker update queued, processing, completed, or failed under the same ID. Make duplicate delivery safe, then verify both a successful export and a worker failure.

learning.assumes: You have seen pages that say 'Processing, check back later' after submitting a heavy task.
learning.outcome: You can identify the API, queue, and worker roles, then use one job ID to distinguish queued, processing, completed, and failed states.

modules.title: How message queues buffer and distribute tasks reliably
How one report export moves through a message queue

items.title: Before: the page waits for all background work
items.text: After the user clicks Export, one request queries data, builds the file, and uploads it. A slow step can leave the page spinning or time out, and the user has no durable task status to check later.

items.title: Enqueue the work and return status through one task ID
items.text: The API creates export_104, enqueues its parameters and ID, and returns that ID. A worker marks the same task processing, then stores either a file location or readable failure. The page shows queued, processing, completed, or failed under that ID. Enqueued means accepted, not completed.

items.title: Verify evidence across the whole path
items.text: Match export_104 across the API response, queued message, worker log, and final UI state. Retry a failed task and confirm duplicate delivery does not create two files. A single 'message enqueued' log does not prove completion.

modules.title: Enqueueing is not completion
modules.text: Ordering and delivery count depend on the queue and its configuration. Reliable systems often redeliver unacknowledged messages, so a worker must handle duplicates and record failures, retries, and final state. Product-specific configuration is outside this introduction.

distinctions.label: Enqueue Operation
distinctions.text: A {c:message-queue} is the infrastructure that buffers and routes messages; {c:enqueue} is the single operation of putting a message into that queue.

distinctions.label: Consumer
distinctions.text: A {c:message-queue} holds pending work; a {c:message-consumer} is the worker process that reads messages from the queue and executes business logic.
